# Tidy Nook

> Tidy Nook publishes practical organization guides for kitchens, closets, small spaces, and bathrooms, compared using product specifications and buyer reviews, with a focus on fit and what to measure before buying. Run by Muhammad Arif. We do not run lab tests.

## Kitchen

- [Best Spice Rack Organizers for Small Kitchens (2026)](https://tidynook.github.io/article-kitchen-spice-rack.html): Two spice organizers compared: a drawer organizer and a 3-tier cabinet, pantry and countertop rack.

## Closet & Small Space

- [Best Over-the-Door Hooks and Organizers for Tiny Closets](https://tidynook.github.io/article-closet-hooks.html): Double hooks and a 5-shelf organizer compared, with what to measure first.

## Bathroom

- [Best Adhesive Shower Caddies With No Drilling](https://tidynook.github.io/article-bathroom-caddy.html): Two rustproof adhesive shower caddy 5-packs compared, plus what to check on your wall.

## About

- [About Tidy Nook](https://tidynook.github.io/about.html): Who runs the site, how products are compared, and how to send corrections.
- [Affiliate Disclosure](https://tidynook.github.io/affiliate-disclosure.html): How Tidy Nook earns through the Amazon Associates program.
- [Privacy Policy](https://tidynook.github.io/privacy-policy.html): What data this site collects and how affiliate cookies work.
